'''Desnoy MWYHL (v1.00)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Desnoy]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed MWYHL Desnoy LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]
